commitResults.messageTitle: Update FindCommand and parser to support prefix-based field search
commitResults.messageBody:
FindCommand now accepts a generic Predicate<Person> instead of only
NameContainsKeywordsPredicate. FindCommandParser parses n/, p/, e/, a/,
m/, and g/ prefixes and combines them with AND logic, requiring at least
one prefix to be present.
